name: Disrupting Logistics

angles.text: As a priest, you know how healing support can sustain an offensive line. The Al'Aketh healers are the linchpin of the cultist assault.
As a rogue, you know the value of slipping behind enemy lines to eliminate healers and disrupt reinforcements.

faq.answer: Disrupting Logistics is a desperate defense against the Al'Aketh assault in the Gustberry Lowlands. A lone defender needs help taking out the enemy's front-line support before the defense collapses.
faq.q: What is the quest Disrupting Logistics?

faq.answer: Al'Aketh cultists are attacking the Gustberry Lowlands with brawlers and healers. Their organized front depends on healing support to keep pressure on the local defenders.
faq.q: Who are the Al'Aketh cultists attacking the lowlands?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh healers keep the vanguard fighters pressing forward. Taking them out may break the assault's momentum and give the defenders a chance to rally and push the cultists back.
faq.q: Why are the Al'Aketh healers specifically targeted?

faq.answer: The assault is taking place in the Gustberry Lowlands, directly down the hill from the defensive outpost. Al'Aketh brawlers and healers have overrun the lowlands and are pressing their attack.
faq.q: Where does this assault take place?

faq.answer: Valennia appears to organize aid and reinforcements. The defender is exasperated that Valennia sent only one adventurer against a massive assault.

aliases: who are my people holding out
faq.answer: A beleaguered defender offers the call for aid as their people near defeat before the Al'Aketh. The defender reveres 'the winds' and needs any fighting force that can turn the battle.
faq.q: Who commands the defense against the Al'Aketh?

sections.body: A fierce assault is bearing down on the defenders above the Gustberry Lowlands. Enemy forces are gathering, and the local lines are near breaking. The commanders expected substantial reinforcements from Valennia, but they must rely on whatever capable hands arrive. Strikes against the enemy's support may be the only way to hold the defense together.
sections.title: A Desperate Defense

sections.body: Al'Aketh brawlers press forward in ranks, sustained by healers who mend their wounds. In the Gustberry Lowlands, taking out those healers can break the cultists' push. That gives the defenders a chance to rally and drive back the invasion.
sections.title: Breaking the Cultist Line

summary: At the Gustberry Lowlands, Al'Aketh cultists are pressing a full-scale assault. Their healers keep the brawlers fighting, and the defenders need help before their lines give way.
